name: status-chip
title: Status Chip
description: Status chip with a distinct icon shape and text per tone, a colour-blind-safe (Okabe-Ito) palette, one shared status map so meanings stay consistent, and a hover/focus tooltip explaining what the status means and what to do next.

meta.stops: Status read wrong by colour-blind users
meta.summary: Status chips that never rely on colour alone, with one shared status map and a tooltip explaining what each status means.
catches: Statuses that differ only by colour (each tone has its own icon)
Inconsistent meanings across screens (one shared map)
Unknown statuses, shown with a fallback meaning
What to do next, explained on hover or focus
limits: Meanings are only as clear as the copy you write
Tooltip content is not reachable on touch without focus
a11y: Chip is a button described by its tooltip (aria-describedby, role=tooltip)
Icon shape plus text per tone; danger is the only solid chip
Tooltip motion skipped under reduced motion
